title: DO DEEP NETWORKS TRANSFER INVARIANCES ACROSS CLASSES?
reasoning: The paper focuses on generalization issues in deep neural networks due to class imbalance in datasets and proposes a method to transfer invariances across classes to improve performance. It discusses how classifiers generalize poorly on unbalanced and long-tailed distributions. While fairness in decision-making is briefly mentioned as a motivation for balanced metrics, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary component.
